verdict.rationale: Square documents its own Payouts API with a List Payouts endpoint, which provides payout records relevant to reconciliation. The 'Manage your cash flow' marketing line loosely supports this but adds little. Evidence is limited to page titles, with nothing showing how payouts tie to daily takings or include fee breakdowns. Missing for 10: itemized transaction and fee reports, payout-to-transaction entry linkage, merchant-facing reconciliation reports in the Dashboard, detailed docs content, independent or hands-on corroboration.
